notes.title: Practice Mode, Improved Restart From Checkpoint, and Other Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New Practice Mode: replay specific level sections without getting a score or rank
[*] Improved “Restart from Checkpoint” feature: restart from any previous checkpoint (not just current or previous). NOTE: you can only restart from any previous checkpoint on new level playthroughs after updating and not on playthroughs from before this update.
[*] Fixed “phantom turns” that can appear under certain conditions in Level 6-9.
[*] Checkpoint score/rank tally is displayed at the end of the final section of Level 9 if the level has been previously completed. This helps those attempting to S-rank Level 9.
[*] Minor menu appearance and behavior fixes and tweaks
[*] Fixed potential hang that can occur when spamming the pause or quick restart button at the end of a level, just before the score tally screen
[*] Fixed visual issues on pause menu when the game scene is partially faded out
[*] Fixed incorrectly swapped X/Y buttons on Nintendo Switch controllers
[*] Potentially confusing “save data corrupted” message changed for clarity. It will only appear in the very rare case when the game fails to recover the most recent valid save.
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Deck and Controller Compatibility Update
notes.content:
Here's an update to ensure the game will work well on Steam Deck. It also improves how the game works with different controller types. It should also let Linux users play the game via Proton (though we don't officially support that).

Here's what's changed:
[list]
[*] Fixed issues Steam Deck compatibility issues
[*] Added support for PS5 and Nintendo Switch controllers
[*] Adjusted trigger vibrations to feel better on Xbox Series S/X controllers
[*] Fixed single frame glitch of whiteness when game starts up
[/list]

notes.title: Maintenance Update (Resolution Options)
notes.content: A small update to fix an issue where resolution options for only the primary display were available. Now resolution options for all displays connected to the primary video card should be available.

notes.title: Thumper Maintenance Update (Keyboard Remap Hang)
notes.content: The latest update fixes a reported hang when attempting to remap the keyboard "SELECT" input on the OPTIONS > CONTROLS screen.

notes.title: Thumper Maintenance Update (VR issues)
notes.content:
The latest update fixes a few issues related to VR mode (both Steam VR and Oculus)
[list]
[*] Fixed re-centering VR position and orientation (hold ESC key OR start/pause button)
[*] Fixed pausing via keyboard (ESC key) in VR mode
[*] Playing in VR mode no longer requires the Thumper desktop window to be focused. This was causing issues where the game appeared to hang when launching into VR mode.
 [/list]

notes.title: Thumper Maintenance Update (DX9 Graphics Issues)
notes.content: The latest update fixes minor visual issues with the "DX9 Legacy" version of the game. The other (DX11) versions are not affected.

notes.title: Thumper Maintenance Update (ASIO crash)

notes.title: Thumper Maintenance Update
notes.content:
A few small fixes are in the latest update:
[list]
[*] Fixed case where game will run in slow motion in Oculus VR mode
[*] Windows 10 exe is only auto-launched when using Windows 10 build 15063 or later. This avoids potential compatibility issues with older Windows 10 releases.
[*] Re-deprecated Razor Chroma support. If it was working for you and you want to keep using it, you can add "-chroma" to your launch options (Library > Thumper > Properties > GENERAL > SET LAUNCH OPTIONS...) 
[/list]

notes.title: Thumper (Final??) Hotfix
notes.content:
Of course our "final" update has to be followed by a "final" hotfix!
[list]
[*] Limit update rate of Xbox One controller vibration in Windows 10 exe to 30Hz to fix trigger vibration issues
[*] Allow alternate key for menu “select” to be remapped on keyboard controls screen
[*] Fixed issue with some keys not working when mapped to gameplay actions
[*] Fixed minor input issues on keyboard controls screen
[*] Prevent boss bonus thumps from unlocking shields when pounded. This prevents bugs that happen when a shield is prematurely unlocked before a boss phrase begins (thanks Hannes!).
[*] Fixed minor issues with DualShock 4 controller in Windows 10 exe
[*] Disable vibration on previous controller when hot swapping to a new controller
[/list]
This should address all known issues we plan to fix. Of course, we'll still be looking out for any new major issues.

notes.title: Thumper (Final?) Update
notes.content:
Our latest update includes many small usability improvements and fixes.

We're not planning further updates at this time, but we'll respond to any new major issues. A special thanks to all the players who've helped us find and fix everything!
[list]
[*] Added controller/keyboard hot swapping support
[*] Improved button/key remapping on controls screen
[*] Added stereo vibration effects for Oculus Touch (Oculus VR Mode)
[*] Removed the three “Win10” launch options. Windows 10 is now detected by the default executable and the Windows 10 compatible executable is automatically launched. If you want to use the Windows 7/8 exe on Windows 10, use the "-force_win8" launch option.
[*] Added automatic pause when active controller is disconnected
[*] Added automatic pause when SteamVR dashboard is displayed (SteamVR Mode)
[*] Added automatic pause when Oculus system menu is displayed (Oculus VR Mode)
[*] Added credits to options menu
[*] Fixed case when pounding boss weapon only spawns one bonus thump instead of two (thanks Austin!)
[*] Fixed occasional extra height jumps/flight (thanks again Austin!)
[*] Fixed checkpoint restart bug that can happen right after checkpoint is passed (thanks tuftyfrog!)
[*] Fixed text overlapping on VR options screen in some languages
[*] Reduced aliasing on keyboard helpbar icons in VR
[*] Razer Chroma support fixed and re-enabled by default
[/list]

[/list]
A few more minor fixes and usability improvements are coming soon.

notes.title: Maintenance/Tech Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
Our data indicates the vast majority of users are playing Thumper without a hitch, but we're aware of some tech issues preventing some players from running the game (and we've seen your support forum posts). We've been sidelined by personal matters and injuries, but we're making a maintenance update a priority now and hope to have it out within the next month or so. 

Thanks for your patience.

That said, if you recently purchased the game and are having problems running it, please don't hesitate to take advantage of Steam's refund policy if you'd prefer not to wait. The last thing we want is for you to get stuck with a game you can't play.

notes.title: VR and Gameplay Usability Update
notes.content:
We've released a small update with some usability improvements and fixes based on player feedback.

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added gamepad analog stick sensitivity adjustment (under Options > Gameplay). If you experience stick "bounce back" issues on multi-lane sections, reducing the sensitivity should help.
    [*]Minor optimizations to DX11 renderer (both VR and non-VR)
[/list] 
[h1]VR Mode[/h1]
[list]
    [*]VR tracking can be manually recentered by holding start/pause button (or ESC key) for 1.5 seconds
    [*]VR tracking auto-recentering can be disabled under Options > VR
    [*]Only tracking position (not orientation) is automatically reset if HMD tracking is lost and reacquired
[/list] 
[h1]SteamVR Mode Specific[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Detect and use correct display adapter (even when it's not the default) 
    [*]SteamVR skybox set to black and DROOL logo displayed during startup
[/list] 
[h1]Oculus VR Mode Specific[/h1]
[list]
    [*]DROOL start up logo moved further away from viewer
[/list] 

Thanks again for playing! We're working on more improvements and we'll continue to monitor the Thumper Community Hub for issues.

notes.title: Pre-Update: DirectX 11 and Minor Fixes
notes.content:
In preparation for a big update next week, we released a small Thumper update today.

First, the game now uses an all-new DirectX 11 graphics engine. Most users should get a small performance boost and there should be no visual difference with the old DirectX 9 renderer.

For compatibility reasons, the DirectX 9 build is still available as a launch option (the executable is also in your install directory: THUMPER_dx9.exe).

This build also fixes some minor bugs users have reported. Thanks for all our feedback!

A lot more coming soon!

notes.title: Update: Restart from Previous Checkpoint, Thumb Relief, and Fixes
notes.content:
Thumper has been updated with some fixes and new features.
[list]
    [*]Restart From Previous Checkpoint. After passing a checkpoint, you can now restart from the immediately proceeding checkpoint (select PREVIOUS from the Restart From Checkpoint screen). Note that you can only restart from the current checkpoint or the immediately previous one. Also note that if you quit the level or app, you lose the ability to restart from the previous checkpoint. This feature is intended to reduce frustration for players who try to grind out S-Ranks.
    [*]Controller thumb relief: R1/RB can be used in addition to (X)/(A) button as the primary gameplay input.
    [*]Press and hold (X)/(A) button to speed up death animation.
    [*]Hold (X)/(A) button on score screen to speed up animation.
    [*]Fixed rare issue causing early damage on turns.
    [*]Fixed rare issue causing energy pulses to "pass through" bosses.
[/list]     
We're still working on more features and fixing additional known issues.

If you're having any trouble with the game, please check our support page (http://thumpergame.com/support) or post on the Steam Community Hub forums (we'll be monitoring it).

The next update is coming soon!
